key_facts: MAJOR UPDATE Thu Aug 27 (T+1d, ~28.4h to Sat Aug 29 00:00 CEST; Exa TV2/VG/Aftenposten/NRK/NTB/AP + local AJ/Daily Beast Aug 27; SUBMITTED Harald V 0.88->0.55, Haakon VIII 0.12->0.45, sum=1.00): At 09:00 CEST Thu Aug 27, Kongehuset announced King Harald V's health had deteriorated despite IV antibiotics for bacteremia and is now 'svært alvorlig' ('extremely/very serious'). Both Queen Sonja and Crown Prince Regent Haakon cancelled ALL royal engagements through Sep 3-4 (including Sep 4 Statsråd). The entire royal family gathered at Rikshospitalet (Sonja, Haakon, Mette-Marit, Ingrid Alexandra, Sverre Magnus, Märtha Louise, Princess Astrid, Marius Borg Høiby). Crucially, PM Jonas Gahr Støre cancelled a Germany trip, Parliament President Masud Gharahkhani cut short an Iceland visit, and Church of Norway bishops cut short a Rome visit to Pope Leo XIV to return to Oslo—strong national-protocol signal of grave, potentially imminent end-of-life risk. However, at 17:00 CEST the Palace reported his condition 'uforandret' (still alive, flag at top of mast); Haakon's family returned to Skaugum around 16:00, Sonja left ~19:30, and Haakon/Mette-Marit returned at 19:37 for evening shift vigil—consistent with a critical ICU/vigil phase that could end tonight/Fri (45% -> Haakon VIII) or extend past Sat Aug 29 00:00 CEST / stabilize (55% -> Harald V).
